audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 1 and 3 read Sett/Skill while the whys hand both to Wukong ('Level 2 flips to you', 'Levels 4-5 favour you'), and rows 5 and 6 read Skill while the whys say Sett stays ahead at first item and two items.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Sett, Wukong, Sett, Wukong, Sett, Sett, Sett] and the mirror audit records the identical chart, so both directions already agree on the true answer.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 3, 5 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group: Wukong, Wukong, Sett, Sett, with ratings moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Sett cooldown appeared anywhere, so 'trade when his grit is spent' had no duration attached and the packet logged zero sequencing cues.
audit.why: Kit: Knuckle Down (Q) 9/8/7/6/5s, Haymaker (W) 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Facebreaker (E) 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s at 490 range, The Show Stopper (R) 120/100/80s at 400 range.
audit.corrected: Haymaker's 18s at rank 1 is now the stated all-in window in the level-2 and levels-4-5 rows, the cooldown block and the level 3-5 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. (1) Facebreaker only STUNS when Sett pulls enemies from opposite sides of himself — against you alone it is a slow, so the page's 'don't get E-stunned' fear is mostly wrong in a 1v1. (2) Haymaker deals TRUE damage only in the centre of the punch; the sides are physical, so standing off-centre changes the trade maths.
audit.why: Riot text — E: 'pulls in all enemies on opposite sides of him... If enemies were only on one side, they are slowed instead of stunned.' W: 'true damage in the center and physical damage on the sides.'
audit.corrected: Both written in: stand off-centre for Haymaker, and treat Facebreaker as a slow unless a teammate is flanking him.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Show Stopper' in mid and whys[4] — the ability is The Show Stopper.
audit.why: packet.suspectNames and packet.enemyAbilities.R both give 'The Show Stopper'.

edits.before: W clone bails out any misstep and baits his answer. Only take the trade when Sett's Haymaker is down.
edits.after: Level 2 is your window: take the quick trade before his grit fills, then leave — Haymaker is 18s at rank 1.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Haymaker's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Yours while his grit is empty: Haymaker is 18s at rank 1, so the 18 seconds after he spends it are your all-in window.

edits.before: - Sett Haymaker: matchup-defining — Shield + true damage. Decoy it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Haymaker: 18s at rank 1 — commit the moment he spends it. - Facebreaker: 16s at rank 1, 490 range, and it only stuns if you are opposite another enemy. - The Show Stopper: 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Shield + true damage. Decoy it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: The true damage is only the centre — stand off-centre and it is physical.

edits.before: Sett wastes Haymaker — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Facebreaker only stuns if he catches you on both sides.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Only Haymaker's centre is true damage; the sides are physical.

edits.before: Track Sett's Haymaker: Shield + true damage. Decoy it. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Facebreaker stuns only if enemies flank him; alone you are just slowed. Then E-Q and R.

edits.before: Level 6 Show Stopper lets his sustain win the all-in.
edits.after: Level 6 The Show Stopper lets his sustain win the all-in.

edits.before: Sett trades well here: his Haymaker (W) shield-and-punch and Knuckle Down (Q) auto resets out-damage your combo when his grit is full. Trade only after he's spent W, and W-decoy his Facebreaker (E) pull-stun.
edits.after: Sett trades well here: Haymaker (W) is 18s at rank 1 and Knuckle Down (Q) hits for max health when his grit is full. Trade in the 18s after he spends W, and Facebreaker (E) only stuns you if an ally is opposite him.

edits.before: Sett largely controls 3-6. His Haymaker shield-and-punch and Facebreaker pull-stun out-trade your Q-W-E, and level 6 Show Stopper sets up an all-in his sustain wins. Only step up when his grit shield is spent, and decoy his E.
edits.after: Sett largely controls 3-6. His Haymaker shield-and-punch and Facebreaker pull out-trade your Q-W-E, and level 6 The Show Stopper sets up an all-in his sustain wins. Step up when his grit is spent — alone, his E only slows you.

notes: The kit flags The Show Stopper with 'grounding'. Riot's own description says only that Sett carries a champion and slams them, with a slow on landing — no grounding text. I did NOT write any grounding claim into the page. Wukong's own kit was null in the brief, so no Wukong cooldowns were added; the mirror audit flags the same gap and it is worth a re-run once champ-data/_kits/wukong.json exists.
